author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0009095 aromatic amino acid biosynthetic process, prephenate pathway
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32005

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed

2 annotations by UP from PMID:21102469 to Arabidopsis PAT and Petunia PPA-AT
Fig 1 shows Petunia PPA-AT RNAi affects L-phenylalanine synthesis, so could reannotate PPA-AT to 'GO:0009094 L-phenylalanine biosynthetic process'
I don't see any evidence for BP annotation to Arabidopsis PAT from this paper (though I could have missed it) so suggest the annotation is just removed from Arabidopsis PA

1 annotation by TAIR from PMID:20883697 to Arabidopsis PAT
This is a biochemical paper, I don't see any BP information - I suggest this annotation is removed.

1 annotation by MTBBASE from PMID:18727669 to M. tuberculosis Rv0948c (chorismate mutase)
This is a biochemical/structural paper, I don't see any BP information - I suggest this annotation is removed.


Impacted groups: 
UniProt 2
TAIR 1
MTBBASE 1


** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
[LIST IDs + ADD ASSIGNEES] 



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0009095 aromatic amino acid biosynthetic process, prephenate pathway

author: pgaudet
body: Term has been obsoleted, any remaining annotation will appear in reports.
